description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project to facilitate platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures. It includes functions to check the image and perform upgrades based on the board name, handling different devices such as Comtrend and Sercomm models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that performs a simple check, always returning success.
